# Canonical remote-URL allowlist patterns for session-sync-init.sh / .ps1 (#1773).
#
# One entry per line, TAB-separated: <SCHEME|SCP><TAB><regex>.
# Lines starting with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
#
# A URL is allowed when it matches SCHEME **or** SCP; otherwise it is refused.
#
# Both patterns must behave identically under POSIX ERE (bash `[[ =~ ]]`) and
# .NET regex (PowerShell `-match`), so neither may use a non-capturing group
# `(?:...)`, a lookaround, or any other non-ERE construct. Capturing groups are
# used wherever grouping is needed; the verdict never depends on a capture.
#
# These are the design's patterns (detail.md Section A2), pinned here so both
# language suites can run the whole contrast table through their own engine and
# prove the two agree — "the pattern string looks identical" is not evidence
# that bash accepts it. The installers must implement these patterns, or an
# equivalent form that returns the same verdict for every table row.
SCHEME	^(https|ssh|git)://([^/@]+@)?(\[[0-9A-Fa-f:]*[0-9A-Fa-f][0-9A-Fa-f:]*\]|[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]*)(:[0-9]+)?(/.*)?$
SCP	^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*@[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]*:[^:].*$
